title: Compilence structural-refusal rank-deficit check
asserted_expression: Rank deficiency of the constraint matrix A by itself implies that Ax=b is inconsistent and therefore structurally must refuse.
asserted_exact_value: rank-deficient A always implies no solution
does_not_establish: This checks only the public wording that rank deficit itself is a refusal condition. Rank deficiency can mean non-unique but consistent solutions. A correct inconsistency test can instead compare rank(A) with rank([A|b]) or use an explicitly declared uniqueness requirement.
source_basis: Public overview/research text presents structural refusal as rank deficit when semantic chains break and describes the constraint matrix as unsatisfied in that case.
